title: One Prompt. A 3D Website.
hook: I typed one sentence. A website built itself.
notes: Every claim below is quoted from signhify.dpdns.org. No invented metrics, customers, or results.

scenes.headline: I typed one sentence.
scenes.narration: I typed one sentence. A website built itself.

scenes.headline: Scroll sites are expensive to build.
scenes.subtext: WebGL, shaders, a whole team. Most of it is skipped.
scenes.narration: Scroll driven sites usually mean WebGL, shaders, and a whole team.

scenes.headline: Three moves.
bullets: Generate an eight second cinematic video
Extract the frames into a scroll sequence
Native browser scroll replays it as parallax
scenes.narration: Signhify generates an eight second video, extracts the frames, and lets native browser scroll replay them as parallax.

scenes.headline: No WebGL. No Three.js.
scenes.subtext: Just native scroll with frame interpolation.
scenes.narration: No WebGL. No Three.js. Just native scroll with frame interpolation.

scenes.headline: What you ship
scenes.narration: Over four hundred frames per site, adjustable between ten and forty frames per second, from an eight second source video.

scenes.headline: You get the code.
scenes.subtext: A ZIP with the frontend, plus a backend starter.
scenes.narration: You export a ZIP with the frontend and a backend starter, under an MIT license.

scenes.headline: Plans start at five dollars a month.
scenes.narration: Plans start at five dollars a month, with full source code ownership.
